# ptymini

> Asyncio pty sessions: spawn, write, multi-client attach with replay, and a named registry

## Modules

- [ptymini.bg](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/ptymini/bg.html.md): The bgterm API: sync, cursor-paged background terminal sessions
- [ptymini.core](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/ptymini/core.html.md): `PtySession` and `PtyRegistry`: asyncio pty sessions over one offset-tracked output ring
